noSeries: This variable has no data at {{place}}.

readout.general: value {{value}} · {{anomaly}} from the usual for that month

anomalies.general: Each month minus the usual value for that calendar month{{unit}}
anomalies.expert: Anomalies{{unit}}: value minus the mean of the same calendar month

running.general: Average of 12 months around each month{{unit}}
running.expert: Centred 12-month mean{{unit}}; needs all 12 months, so gaps stay gaps

trend.expert: Linear trend of the monthly anomalies (slope from the analysis, drawn through the mean of the analysed months).

band.general: Shaded: how uncertain the slope is. It is not a forecast.
band.expert: {{level}}% CI of the slope, not a prediction interval.

break.general: Dashed: a month when the data product changed ({{months}}).

key.cursor: Timeline month; click the chart to jump.

stats.none: No trend statistics for this series.
stats.method: Method: least-squares slope of monthly anomalies. The t-test and CI use an effective sample size from the lag-1 autocorrelation of the residuals. FDR is Benjamini-Hochberg across the analysed series of one family (Taiwan's series are one family, the world cities and the global mean another). The Sen slope CI has no autocorrelation correction.

text.general: (exploratory): other measurements that ran high and low in the same months.
text.expert: (exploratory): which other variables went above and below normal in the same months.
